name: Gelo 7 — Explosão

source.sourceVariant: approved five-frame version with 120px transparent spacing

preservationPolicy: Keep the approved 2528x672 spaced PNG byte-for-byte unchanged, including transparency. No crop, redraw, resize, frame repacking or gameplay activation without explicit approval.
notes: Gelo 7 — Explosão reserved for future use. Must not replace active Raio de Gelo casting-ice and ice-shards-v26 or other reserved ice effects. Mapping recorded only; timing and anchor still await future integration decisions.
